mapper.select: SELECT ORG_MBR_SN AS ORGANIZATION_MEMBER_ID, FRST_CLSF_CD AS FIRST_CATEGORY_CODE, FRST_CLSF_NM AS FIRST_CATEGORY_NAME, SCND_CLSF_CD AS SECOND_CATEGORY_CODE, SCND_CLSF_NM AS SECOND_CATEGORY_NAME, TASK_CN AS TASK, TELNO AS TELEPHONE, SORT_SEQ AS SORT_SEQUENCE FROM HMPG_ORG_MEMBER WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CASE SCND_CLSF_CD WHEN 'DIRECTOR' THEN 1 WHEN 'PLAN' THEN 2 WHEN 'EDU' THEN 3 WHEN 'FACILITY' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, SORT_SEQ DESC, ORG_MBR_SN ASC
